from fastmcp import FastMCP, Context
from typing import List

mcp = FastMCP("progress-logger", instructions="Tool that processes items and reports progress")

@mcp.tool()
async def process_items(items: List[str], ctx: Context) -> dict:
    """Process a list of items and report progress via MCP context logging."""
    results = []
    total = len(items)
    
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        # Log progress via MCP context
        await ctx.info(f"Processing item {i}/{total}: {item}")
        
        # Report progress
        await ctx.report_progress(i, total, f"Processing {item}")
        
        # Simulate processing
        processed = f"Processed: {item.upper()}"
        results.append(processed)
    
    await ctx.info("All items processed successfully")
    
    return {
        "status": "complete",
        "items_processed": len(results),
        "results": results
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()
